rawConfiguration.text:
## Payment gateway (`service.name = payment-gateway`, `${environment}`)
Gin `POST /webhook` (Paddle) + `GET /readyz`. Watches: HMAC/signature failures (attack or secret drift), events-Redis dedup hits (`paddle:evt`), MQ quorum publish errors. Secrets: `detectai/gateway/secrets`, `detectai/mq/urls`.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE `http.status_code` >= '500') AS `5xx %` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'

FROM Log SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `hmac fails/min` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%HMAC%' OR message LIKE '%signature%invalid%' OR message LIKE '%webhook%secret%'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS events FACET message WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%webhook%' OR message LIKE '%paddle%' OR message LIKE '%dedup%') LIMIT 25

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `client spans/min` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'CLIENT' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%mq%publish%fail%' OR message LIKE '%rabbitmq%' FACET message TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `dedup events` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%dedup%' OR message LIKE '%duplicate%' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) AS `redis avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND name LIKE '%redis%' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(go_goroutines) AS goroutines, average(go_gc_pause_ms) AS `gc pause ms` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (level = 'error' OR severity = 'ERROR') FACET `http.route` LIMIT 20
